display_name: National Health Insurance Law 5754-1994 ss 2 (income), 14, 15: the health insurance contribution of an insured person for a month (who pays, the rates, the reduced amount, the fixed amounts, the exemptions)

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Hebrew from the Law is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated mechanically from line N of the deposited source by tools/srcquote.py. Hebrew from the deposited National Insurance Law is on lines tagged `-- ext:[NII] |`, generated the same way.

source.authority: aid: unofficial Hebrew Wikisource consolidation, as amended at retrieval (page revision 3081417)

other_sources.what: National Insurance Law [Consolidated Version] 5755-1995, deposited text: lines 191 (the basic amount, note 10,382 for 2026), 3605 (s 334(a), note 7,703 for 2026), 3655 (s 341), 4758 (Schedule K item 1); quoted for the provenance of published figures only
National Insurance (Reduced Rates of Insurance Contributions) Order 5759-1999 s 1 (half the average wage, read as the reduced collection threshold by s 341); read, not quoted

scope: Encoded: s 2 'income'; s 14(a) as far as the contribution reads it; s 14(b)(1), (b)(2), (c)(1), (c)(2), (d)(1)-(3), (e)(1)-(4), (e1), (f), (f1), (g), (g1), (g2). Out of scope, with reasons in NOTES.md section 2: s 14(d)(4), (h), (i), (j); s 15(c) and ss 15A-20A (financing); ss 1, 3-13, 21-46B (services, sick funds); s 47 (offences); ss 48-54; s 55-58 and 59-69A; the Schedules (the basket). The question answered: the health insurance contribution of one insured person for one calendar month from January 2026, and who is liable to pay it. Amounts before rounding. The 2026 figures (reduced amount 7,703; maximum income 51,910; minimum amount 123; pension amounts 237 and 340) are in a published-figures module marked not law; the rules take them as an argument. Six forks (F1 ceiling, F2 minimum income, F3 reduced rate for a benefit, F4 pensioner-employee, F5 computed nothing, F6 benefit and income together) are named switches ruled by Meng on 2026-10-08 (SHRUG), declined by default where their readings differ.

period_answered.text: contribution months from January 2026; earlier months declined by name
period_answered.published_figures: 2026; for another year the caller supplies the figures record

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source, and no independent test pass has been run yet. Every expected value in nhi-il25-tests.l4 was worked by hand from the Hebrew text before it was asserted.
